scripts.build:android:web: NATIVE_PLATFORM=Android node --env-file-if-exists=.env.android.local scripts/validate-native-api.mjs && tsc -b && vite build --mode android
scripts.android:apk: npm run build:android:web && npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios:web: NATIVE_PLATFORM=iOS node --env-file-if-exists=.env.ios.local scripts/validate-native-api.mjs && tsc -b && vite build --mode ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run build:ios:web && npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/App/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:open: npm run build:ios:web && npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
